instruction: Extract the audio from the music video, convert it to MP3, and save it on the Desktop as 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting audio from video using VLC and saving as MP3. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists (40% score), (2) format is MP3 by checking file signature (30% score), (3) file size is reasonable - at least 1MB to ensure non-empty audio (30% score). The gold file is ~3.5MB, so 1MB minimum is a reasonable threshold.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: file creation, MP3 format, correct filename/location, and valid audio content
Getter uses robust file signature checking (ID3 tag and MPEG frame sync) to verify MP3 format, not just file extension
File size check (>= 1MB) is reasonable for audio extracted from video, ensuring non-empty/non-corrupted output
Correct parameter handling: metric directly accesses expected.get('format') and expected.get('min_size') for type='rule'
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts file state (exists, format, size) and metric compares against expected values
Complete coverage: checks file existence, format correctness, location accuracy, and content validity
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider reducing partial credit for file existence alone (currently 40%) to incentivize correct format and size - e.g., 20% for existence, 40% for format, 40% for size
